title: Cow waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#f4f4ff'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='78' width='7' height='15' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f8'/>
  <rect x='60' y='78' width='7' height='15' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f8'/>
  <rect x='33' y='78' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a4a6a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='78' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a4a6a'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='66' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#5a4a6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='72' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#5a4a6a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#f4f4ff'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='32' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e8e8f8' transform='rotate(-20 32 32)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='32' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e8e8f8' transform='rotate(20 68 32)'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='27' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#f0d0a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='27' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#f0d0a0'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#ffc4d6'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='49' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#b06a8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='49' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#b06a8a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='37' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='37' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M44 54 Q50 58 56 54' stroke='#b06a8a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d='M72 62 Q82 56 84 44' stroke='#f4f4ff' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='41' r='5' fill='#f4f4ff'/>
  <path d='M83 38 L82 34 M86 37 L87 33 M88 40 L91 38' stroke='#f4f4ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d='M28 64 Q22 68 21 74' stroke='#f4f4ff' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M76 70 Q84 72 85 78' stroke='#e8e8f8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='79' r='3' fill='#5a4a6a'/>
</svg>
